name: The First Wave of Repressions Against the "Sixtiers" (1965–1968) (C0088)

techniques.comment: Targeted arrests of the new Ukrainian intelligentsia, dissidents, and protest participants (including after the premiere of "Shadows of Forgotten Ancestors") to suppress the nascent resistance(Citation: ДИССИДЕНТСКОЕ ДВИЖЕНИЕ В УКРАИНЕ (1954 – 1987) 2026).

Use of political trials, interrogations, and administrative pressure by the KGB on the signatories of the "Letter of 139" to create an atmosphere of fear in cultural circles: "Administrative repressions against the 'signatories' began, along with KGB pressure. Rumors spread across Kyiv and Ukraine about the existence of an underground terrorist Banderite organization run by Western intelligence services"(Citation: Горська Алла Олександрівна 2005).
